note: attacker-controlled polygon enters the max-size estimate; its vertices drive the bbox and the per-cell count that sizes the output buffer
estimate accumulates the number of output cells into *out (the sz used by the caller); this count can undercount cells whose boundary crosses the polygon
harness allocates the caller-provided output buffer using the undercounted estimate sz
the only capacity enforcement is compiled out under H3_POLYGON_TO_CELLS_ASSERT; the safety obligation that the write index stay below the buffer capacity is never checked
unchecked write loop; when the generated cell count exceeds the buffer size, this performs the out-of-bounds heap write
